limitations: Authentication only: no model requests or quality/cache qualification.
Refresh is observed only when native Pi decides it is due; expiry is never changed.
Reopen uses a new public ModelRuntime in the same process, not a process crash.

specification.prompt: Reply with exactly this text and nothing else: PI_LOGIN_OK
specification.qualification: one authentication smoke request; not a quality or cache study

reproduction.scope: Run from the recorded clean source revision. The smoke consumes subscription allowance; explicitly authorize one call before reproducing. It is separate from the extensive quality/cache study allowance.

interpretation: The native refresh function completed once; Pi resolved auth and a second ModelRuntime read the original credential store without another refresh.
After that process exited, a separate process used the same profile for one exact PI_LOGIN_OK response with valid terminal usage; it observed no further refresh.
The smoke refresh counter is zero because renewal occurred in the earlier authentication-check process, linked by its artifact hash.
Token identities and credential contents were not inspected, compared, copied or published. These observations establish reuse, not the identity of individual tokens.
The single call used 18 input and 7 output tokens; actual subscription charge and remaining account quota are unknown.
Injected refresh/failure tests remain separate from the observed live successful renewal.
notQualified: Other accounts, models, providers or Pi versions
